group.title: Board-revision transition
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Engineering change notice EC-46
Revision F adds a labelled test pad to the controller board. Board dimensions, connector positions, and firmware remain unchanged. Revision F will replace revision E for new production beginning November 20. Existing revision E boards may still be used for service repairs after serial-number compatibility is checked. They must not be discarded solely because a new revision exists.

DOCUMENT 2 — Purchasing message, November 12
We have 200 revision E boards in stock. Please move them to the service-stock location and identify them clearly. The supplier expects to deliver 100 revision F boards on November 18. Incoming inspection must accept those boards before they are issued to the November 20 build.

DOCUMENT 3 — Production reply
We will use revision F for the new build. If the delivery is late or incoming inspection is not complete, we will inform planning and wait for instructions. We will not substitute revision E without written engineering approval.
group.passageZh:
文件一——工程變更通知 EC-46
F 版在控制板上新增一個有標示的測試焊墊。板子尺寸、連接器位置及韌體保持不變。十一月二十日起，新投產批次使用 F 版取代 E 版。既有 E 版依序號確認相容性後仍可用於維修，不得僅因有新版就報廢。

文件二——十一月十二日採購訊息
庫存有兩百片 E 版。請把這批板子移到維修備品存放區，並清楚標示。供應商預計十一月十八日交付一百片 F 版。這批板子須先通過進料檢驗，才能發給十一月二十日的生產批次。

文件三——生產部回覆
新批次會使用 F 版。若交貨延誤或進料檢驗未完成，我們會通知生管並等待指示。未取得工程部門書面核准，不會改用 E 版。
